description:
TILLA's free sample, the same for every plan, no key needed: what it holds and where to download it - the
FULL DAY (one whole UTC day of every raw and node raw table, SQLite, /v1/sample/day.db) and ONE TICK (every
datapoint at one moment, CSV, /v1/sample/tick.csv). `tier` is accepted for older callers and ignored: every plan
holds the same data, plans differ only by history (2026-11-25).
name: tilla_sample
title: Free sample of a plan
